title: AI Visibility Index, August 2026
excerpt: 94.8% of audited sites are never named in an AI assistant's answer about their own category. A study of 531 website audits.
content_html:
Our Terms and Privacy Policy were updated on July 27, 2026. Read the Terms and the Privacy Policy.

What the AI Visibility Index measures

The Index tracks two things separately, because "being visible to AI" is really two problems with two different causes.

Answer presence

A customer asks an assistant for the best provider of a category in a place, and the assistant answers with a handful of names. This pillar asks whether the audited business is one of those names. Every audited business is queried against ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity, and each answer is matched against the audited business.

Machine readability

This pillar is what an assistant's crawler finds on arrival: whether robots.txt lets it in, whether the site publishes a sitemap, whether the homepage states the business's identity and location in machine-readable form. Every one of these signals is first-party, read by our own crawler directly from the site.

Presence is the outcome; readability is the input under a site owner's control. A site can be perfectly marked up and still go unnamed, which is why both are published side by side rather than combined into a single score. The signals come from the same free scan anyone can run on their own site.

Key findings

  1. 94.8%

    of audited sites never surface in an AI answer

    Only 10 of 193 sites were named even once across 5,978 assistant answers to buying-intent questions.

  2. 2.9%

    Gemini has the widest reach in the panel

    Gemini named the audited business in 2.9% of its answers, ahead of every other assistant in the panel. All four were asked the same questions about the same businesses on the same days, so the gap is a difference between assistants rather than a difference between questions.

  3. 8.9%

    block at least one AI crawler in robots.txt

    39 of 436 sites disallow an AI user-agent outright, most of them without distinguishing between crawlers that train models and agents that fetch a page to answer a live question.

  4. 38

    sites block GPTBot; only 4 block OAI-SearchBot

    Blocking is aimed at training crawlers rather than at retrieval agents. GPTBot is disallowed by 38 sites and ClaudeBot by 36, while the agents that actually fetch a page to answer a live question, OAI-SearchBot and Perplexity-User, are disallowed by 4 sites and 3 sites. A site that blocks the whole group pays for it in lost citations.

  5. 54.6%

    publish any schema.org structured data

    238 of 436 sites carry structured data on their homepage. The rest leave an assistant nothing to read but prose.

  6. 19.3%

    publish LocalBusiness schema

    The markup that states a business's name, address and category in machine-readable form is the least-adopted signal measured here, present on 84 sites. Most of this corpus is local businesses.

The data

Methodology

The dataset

Every figure comes from audits run through Website Auditor's free scanner between 2026-03-30 and 2026-08-02: 531 stored audits across 458 distinct domains, in 38 detected sectors. Aggregates are computed over Website Auditor's reports, the analytics view that excludes our own parent company auditing its own properties, so internal traffic cannot inflate a share. The aggregate itself is committed as a SQL function and re-run unchanged for every edition, so one edition is a comparison against the last rather than a fresh set of judgement calls.

How each number is calculated

  • One domain, one vote. Both pillars use the most recent audit per domain. Counting audits instead would give a site scanned nine times nine times the influence over every share.
  • Answer presence covers 2026-07-23 to 2026-08-02: 193 sites and 5,978 assistant answers. A site counts as present if it was named in at least one answer from at least one assistant.
  • Machine readability covers 2026-05-16 to 2026-08-02 across 436 sites, a longer window and a larger sample, because these signals are read by our own crawler and depend on no third-party provider.
  • Failed queries are excluded, not counted as absences. A provider timeout is a fact about the provider, not evidence about the business. Per-assistant failure counts are published above, so a smaller denominator is something a reader can see rather than an inference.
  • Every percentage is a derivation. The published dataset holds integer counts only, and every share on this page is computed from two of them at render time. A headline therefore cannot drift away from its own data.

Assumptions and limitations

Every figure above comes with conditions, and these are the conditions. They are published with the same weight as the findings.

  • The corpus is self-selected, not a random sample of the web: every site in it is one whose owner chose to run a free audit, which skews toward small and mid-sized businesses actively working on their web presence. Treat the shares as descriptive of that population, not of all websites.
  • Cross-assistant figures start on 2026-07-23 because earlier audits fanned a single Perplexity answer across the ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini cards. Those earlier rows are real answers, but all of them are Perplexity's, so comparing assistants over them would measure one provider against its own output.
  • ChatGPT answered 1,352 of its 1,544 panel queries; the 192 that failed at the provider are excluded from its denominator rather than counted as absences. Its rate therefore rests on a smaller sample than every other assistant in the panel.
  • Appearance is measured by matching the audited business against the businesses named in an assistant's answer. Name matching is fuzzy, and a business identified only by its domain, roughly one in five, is the hardest case. Presence is therefore more likely to be an under-count than an over-count.
  • Assistants are non-deterministic, and their indexes are in constant motion. These figures describe the answers given inside the stated window; the same queries run after 2026-08-02 will produce different answers.
  • Crawl signals are read from three places only: the homepage, robots.txt and sitemap.xml. A site carrying structured data on its inner pages but not on its homepage is counted here as a site with no structured data.
  • The structured-data figures in this edition are an under-count. Until 2026-08-02 the detector read only the top level of each JSON-LD block, so it missed the @graph container that Yoast and most of the WordPress ecosystem use to wrap their markup. A site publishing correct LocalBusiness schema that way is counted here as a site with no structured data. The detector was corrected on that date, so this signal is not comparable with the next edition.

Citation and reuse

Figures are free to reproduce with attribution and a link to this page. For the underlying methodology, or a cut of the data for a specific sector, write to support@website-auditor.io with your question.

Update history

This page is the permanent home of the Index. Each new edition updates the figures above and adds a dated row here rather than moving to a new URL, so links and citations keep resolving to current data.

  1. 2026-08-02

    Second edition. The panel grew from 175 sites to 193 sites and now runs to 2026-08-02, and the crawl-signal corpus grew from 418 sites to 436 sites. Every headline share moved by less than a point: a slightly smaller share of sites named in an answer, and a slightly smaller share blocking an AI crawler. Gemini keeps the panel's widest reach.

  2. 2026-07-31

    First edition. Cross-assistant presence measured over 2026-07-23 to 2026-07-31, the first period in which ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity were each queried through their own provider. Crawl signals measured across 418 sites audited since 2026-05-16, at one audit per domain.

Where does your site sit in this data?

The Index is built from the same free audit anyone can run on their own site. It checks the AI-readiness signals measured above and queries all four assistants for your business by name, with no signup and a result in about a minute.

Run a free AI visibility audit

blocks.html_en: The dataset

sentences.en: The dataset
sentences.zh: 数据集

blocks.html_en: Every figure comes from audits run through Website Auditor's free scanner between 2026-03-30 and 2026-08-02: 531 stored audits across 458 distinct domains, in 38 detected sectors. Aggregates are computed over Website Auditor's reports, the analytics view that excludes our own parent company auditing its own properties, so internal traffic cannot inflate a share. The aggregate itself is committed as a SQL function and re-run unchanged for every edition, so one edition is a comparison against the last rather than a fresh set of judgement calls.

sentences.en: Every figure comes from audits run through Website Auditor's free scanner between 2026-03-30 and 2026-08-02: 531 stored audits across 458 distinct domains, in 38 detected sectors.
sentences.zh: 每个数字均来自 2026 年 3 月 30 日至 2026 年 8 月 2 日期间通过 Website Auditor 的免费扫描仪运行的审核：在 38 个检测到的扇区中，跨 458 个不同域的 531 项存储审核。

sentences.en: Aggregates are computed over Website Auditor's reports, the analytics view that excludes our own parent company auditing its own properties, so internal traffic cannot inflate a share.
sentences.zh: 聚合是根据网站审计员的报告计算的，分析视图不包括我们自己的母公司审计其自己的财产，因此内部流量不会夸大份额。

sentences.en: The aggregate itself is committed as a SQL function and re-run unchanged for every edition, so one edition is a comparison against the last rather than a fresh set of judgement calls.
sentences.zh: 聚合本身作为 SQL 函数提交，并在每个版本中不加更改地重新运行，因此一个版本是与上一个版本的比较，而不是一组新的判断调用。

blocks.html_en: How each number is calculated

sentences.en: How each number is calculated
sentences.zh: 每个数字是如何计算的

blocks.html_en: • One domain, one vote. Both pillars use the most recent audit per domain. Counting audits instead would give a site scanned nine times nine times the influence over every share.

sentences.en: One domain, one vote.
sentences.zh: 一个域名，一票。

sentences.en: Both pillars use the most recent audit per domain.
sentences.zh: 两个支柱都使用每个域的最新审计。

sentences.en: Counting audits instead would give a site scanned nine times nine times the influence over every share.
sentences.zh: 相反，如果计算审计次数，网站被扫描九次的影响力将是每次分享的九倍。

blocks.html_en: • Answer presence covers 2026-07-23 to 2026-08-02: 193 sites and 5,978 assistant answers. A site counts as present if it was named in at least one answer from at least one assistant.

sentences.en: Answer presence covers 2026-07-23 to 2026-08-02: 193 sites and 5,978 assistant answers.
sentences.zh: 答复状态涵盖 2026 年 7 月 23 日至 2026 年 8 月 2 日：193 个站点和 5,978 个助理答复。

sentences.en: A site counts as present if it was named in at least one answer from at least one assistant.
sentences.zh: 如果某个网站在至少一名助理的至少一个答案中被提及，则该网站被视为存在。

blocks.html_en: • Machine readability covers 2026-05-16 to 2026-08-02 across 436 sites, a longer window and a larger sample, because these signals are read by our own crawler and depend on no third-party provider.

sentences.en: Machine readability covers 2026-05-16 to 2026-08-02 across 436 sites, a longer window and a larger sample, because these signals are read by our own crawler and depend on no third-party provider.
sentences.zh: 机器可读性涵盖 2026-05-16 至 2026-08-02 的 436 个站点，更长的窗口和更大的样本，因为这些信号是由我们自己的爬虫读取的，不依赖于第三方提供商。

blocks.html_en: • Failed queries are excluded, not counted as absences. A provider timeout is a fact about the provider, not evidence about the business. Per-assistant failure counts are published above, so a smaller denominator is something a reader can see rather than an inference.

sentences.en: Failed queries are excluded, not counted as absences.
sentences.zh: 失败的查询被排除，不计为缺勤。

sentences.en: A provider timeout is a fact about the provider, not evidence about the business.
sentences.zh: 提供程序超时是有关提供程序的事实，而不是有关业务的证据。

sentences.en: Per-assistant failure counts are published above, so a smaller denominator is something a reader can see rather than an inference.
sentences.zh: 每个助手的失败计数已在上面发布，因此较小的分母是读者可以看到的而不是推论。

blocks.html_en: • Every percentage is a derivation. The published dataset holds integer counts only, and every share on this page is computed from two of them at render time. A headline therefore cannot drift away from its own data.

sentences.en: Every percentage is a derivation.
sentences.zh: 每个百分比都是一个推导。

sentences.en: The published dataset holds integer counts only, and every share on this page is computed from two of them at render time.
sentences.zh: 已发布的数据集仅保存整数计数，并且此页面上的每个份额都是在渲染时根据其中两个计算得出的。

sentences.en: A headline therefore cannot drift away from its own data.
sentences.zh: 因此，标题不能偏离其本身的数据。

blocks.html_en: Assumptions and limitations

sentences.en: Assumptions and limitations
sentences.zh: 假设和限制

blocks.html_en: Every figure above comes with conditions, and these are the conditions. They are published with the same weight as the findings.

sentences.en: Every figure above comes with conditions, and these are the conditions.
sentences.zh: 上面的每一个数字都是有条件的，这些就是条件。

sentences.en: They are published with the same weight as the findings.
sentences.zh: 它们的发表与研究结果具有同等的分量。

blocks.html_en: • The corpus is self-selected, not a random sample of the web: every site in it is one whose owner chose to run a free audit, which skews toward small and mid-sized businesses actively working on their web presence. Treat the shares as descriptive of that population, not of all websites.

sentences.en: The corpus is self-selected, not a random sample of the web: every site in it is one whose owner chose to run a free audit, which skews toward small and mid-sized businesses actively working on their web presence.
sentences.zh: 该语料库是自我选择的，而不是网络的随机样本：其中的每个网站都是其所有者选择进行免费审核的网站，这倾向于积极致力于其网络存在的中小型企业。

sentences.en: Treat the shares as descriptive of that population, not of all websites.
sentences.zh: 将共享视为对该人群的描述，而不是对所有网站的描述。

blocks.html_en: • Cross-assistant figures start on 2026-07-23 because earlier audits fanned a single Perplexity answer across the ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini cards. Those earlier rows are real answers, but all of them are Perplexity's, so comparing assistants over them would measure one provider against its own output.

sentences.en: Cross-assistant figures start on 2026-07-23 because earlier audits fanned a single Perplexity answer across the ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini cards.
sentences.zh: 跨助理数据从 2026 年 7 月 23 日开始，因为早期的审计在 ChatGPT、Claude 和 Gemini 卡上得出了单一的 Perplexity 答案。

sentences.en: Those earlier rows are real answers, but all of them are Perplexity's, so comparing assistants over them would measure one provider against its own output.
sentences.zh: 前面的几行是真正的答案，但它们都是 Perplexity 的，因此将助手与它们进行比较将根据一个提供商自己的输出来衡量。

blocks.html_en: • ChatGPT answered 1,352 of its 1,544 panel queries; the 192 that failed at the provider are excluded from its denominator rather than counted as absences. Its rate therefore rests on a smaller sample than every other assistant in the panel.

sentences.en: ChatGPT answered 1,352 of its 1,544 panel queries; the 192 that failed at the provider are excluded from its denominator rather than counted as absences.
sentences.zh: ChatGPT 回答了 1,544 个小组查询中的 1,352 个；在提供者处不及格的 192 人被排除在分母之外，而不计为缺勤。

sentences.en: Its rate therefore rests on a smaller sample than every other assistant in the panel.
sentences.zh: 因此，它的比率取决于比小组中其他所有助手更小的样本。

blocks.html_en: • Appearance is measured by matching the audited business against the businesses named in an assistant's answer. Name matching is fuzzy, and a business identified only by its domain, roughly one in five, is the hardest case. Presence is therefore more likely to be an under-count than an over-count.

sentences.en: Appearance is measured by matching the audited business against the businesses named in an assistant's answer.
sentences.zh: 外观是通过将审核的企业与助理答案中指定的企业进行匹配来衡量的。

sentences.en: Name matching is fuzzy, and a business identified only by its domain, roughly one in five, is the hardest case.
sentences.zh: 名称匹配是模糊的，仅通过其域来识别的企业（大约五分之一）是最困难的情况。

sentences.en: Presence is therefore more likely to be an under-count than an over-count.
sentences.zh: 因此，存在的情况更有可能是少算而不是多算。

blocks.html_en: • Assistants are non-deterministic, and their indexes are in constant motion. These figures describe the answers given inside the stated window; the same queries run after 2026-08-02 will produce different answers.

sentences.en: Assistants are non-deterministic, and their indexes are in constant motion.
sentences.zh: 助手是不确定的，它们的索引在不断变化。

sentences.en: These figures describe the answers given inside the stated window; the same queries run after 2026-08-02 will produce different answers.
sentences.zh: 这些数字描述了在指定窗口内给出的答案； 2026 年 8 月 2 日之后运行的相同查询将产生不同的答案。

blocks.html_en: • Crawl signals are read from three places only: the homepage, robots.txt and sitemap.xml. A site carrying structured data on its inner pages but not on its homepage is counted here as a site with no structured data.

sentences.en: Crawl signals are read from three places only: the homepage, robots.txt and sitemap.xml.
sentences.zh: 抓取信号仅从三个位置读取：主页、robots.txt 和 sitemap.xml。

sentences.en: A site carrying structured data on its inner pages but not on its homepage is counted here as a site with no structured data.
sentences.zh: 在内页上包含结构化数据但在主页上不包含结构化数据的网站在此被视为没有结构化数据的网站。

blocks.html_en: • The structured-data figures in this edition are an under-count. Until 2026-08-02 the detector read only the top level of each JSON-LD block, so it missed the @graph container that Yoast and most of the WordPress ecosystem use to wrap their markup. A site publishing correct LocalBusiness schema that way is counted here as a site with no structured data. The detector was corrected on that date, so this signal is not comparable with the next edition.

sentences.en: The structured-data figures in this edition are an under-count.
sentences.zh: 本版中的结构化数据数据统计不足。

sentences.en: Until 2026-08-02 the detector read only the top level of each JSON-LD block, so it missed the @graph container that Yoast and most of the WordPress ecosystem use to wrap their markup.
sentences.zh: 直到 2026 年 8 月 2 日，检测器仅读取每个 JSON-LD 块的顶层，因此它错过了 Yoast 和大多数 WordPress 生态系统用来包装其标记的 @graph 容器。

sentences.en: A site publishing correct LocalBusiness schema that way is counted here as a site with no structured data.
sentences.zh: 以这种方式发布正确的 LocalBusiness 架构的网站在此处算作没有结构化数据的网站。

sentences.en: The detector was corrected on that date, so this signal is not comparable with the next edition.
sentences.zh: 探测器在该日期进行了修正，因此该信号无法与下一版本进行比较。

content_html_zh:
我们的条款和隐私政策于 2026 年 7 月 27 日更新。 阅读条款和隐私政策。

AI 可见性指数衡量的是什么

该指数分别跟踪两件事，因为“人工智能可见”实际上是两个问题，有两个不同的原因。

回答存在

一位顾客向助理询问某个地方某个类别的最佳提供商，助理回答了几个名字。 该支柱询问被审计的企业是否属于这些名称之一。 每个被审计的业务都会针对 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 和 Perplexity 进行查询，并且每个答案都与被审计的业务进行匹配。

机器可读性

这个支柱是助理的爬虫在到达时发现的内容：robots.txt 是否允许其进入、网站是否发布站点地图、主页是否以机器可读的形式说明企业的身份和位置。 这些信号中的每一个都是第一方的，由我们自己的爬虫直接从网站读取。

存在就是结果；可读性是站点所有者控制下的输入。 一个网站可以被完美标记，但仍然未命名，这就是为什么两个网站并排发布而不是合并成一个分数的原因。 这些信号来自任何人都可以在自己的网站上运行的相同免费扫描。

主要发现

  1. 94.8% 的经审核网站从未出现在人工智能答案中 在 5,978 个购买意向问题的助理答案中，193 个网站中只有 10 个被命名过一次。
  2. 2.9% Gemini 在小组中影响范围最广 Gemini 在 2.9% 的答案中提到了经审计的业务，领先于小组中的所有其他助理。 所有四个人在同一天都被问及有关相同业务的相同问题，因此差距是助理之间的差异，而不是问题之间的差异。
  3. 8.9% 在 robots.txt 中阻止至少一个 AI 爬虫 436 个站点中的 39 个站点完全禁止 AI 用户代理，其中大多数站点没有区分训练模型的爬虫和获取页面以回答实时问题的代理。
  4. 38 个站点屏蔽 GPTBot；仅 4 块 OAI-SearchBot Blocking 的目的是训练爬虫而不是检索代理。 GPTBot 被 38 个站点禁止，ClaudeBot 被 36 个站点禁止，而实际获取页面以回答实时问题的代理 OAI-SearchBot 和 Perplexity-User 被 4 个站点和 3 个站点禁止。 屏蔽整个群体的网站会以丢失引用的方式付出代价。
  5. 54.6% 发布任何 schema.org 结构化数据 436 个站点中的 238 个在其主页上包含结构化数据。 其余的留给助手的只有散文，什么也看不了。
  6. 19.3% 发布 LocalBusiness 模式 以机器可读形式说明企业名称、地址和类别的标记是此处测量中采用最少的信号，存在于 84 个站点上。 该语料库大部分是本地企业。

数据

方法论

数据集

每个数字均来自 2026 年 3 月 30 日至 2026 年 8 月 2 日期间通过 Website Auditor 的免费扫描仪运行的审核：在 38 个检测到的扇区中，跨 458 个不同域的 531 项存储审核。 聚合是根据网站审计员的报告计算的，分析视图不包括我们自己的母公司审计其自己的财产，因此内部流量不会夸大份额。 聚合本身作为 SQL 函数提交，并在每个版本中不加更改地重新运行，因此一个版本是与上一个版本的比较，而不是一组新的判断调用。

每个数字是如何计算的

  • 一个域名，一票。 两个支柱都使用每个域的最新审计。 相反，如果计算审计次数，网站被扫描九次的影响力将是每次分享的九倍。
  • 答复状态涵盖 2026 年 7 月 23 日至 2026 年 8 月 2 日：193 个站点和 5,978 个助理答复。 如果某个网站在至少一名助理的至少一个答案中被提及，则该网站被视为存在。
  • 机器可读性涵盖 2026-05-16 至 2026-08-02 的 436 个站点，更长的窗口和更大的样本，因为这些信号是由我们自己的爬虫读取的，不依赖于第三方提供商。
  • 失败的查询被排除，不计为缺勤。 提供程序超时是有关提供程序的事实，而不是有关业务的证据。 每个助手的失败计数已在上面发布，因此较小的分母是读者可以看到的而不是推论。
  • 每个百分比都是一个推导。 已发布的数据集仅保存整数计数，并且此页面上的每个份额都是在渲染时根据其中两个计算得出的。 因此，标题不能偏离其本身的数据。

假设和限制

上面的每一个数字都是有条件的，这些就是条件。 它们的发表与研究结果具有同等的分量。

  • 该语料库是自我选择的，而不是网络的随机样本：其中的每个网站都是其所有者选择进行免费审核的网站，这倾向于积极致力于其网络存在的中小型企业。 将共享视为对该人群的描述，而不是对所有网站的描述。
  • 跨助理数据从 2026 年 7 月 23 日开始，因为早期的审计在 ChatGPT、Claude 和 Gemini 卡上得出了单一的 Perplexity 答案。 前面的几行是真正的答案，但它们都是 Perplexity 的，因此将助手与它们进行比较将根据一个提供商自己的输出来衡量。
  • ChatGPT 回答了 1,544 个小组查询中的 1,352 个；在提供者处不及格的 192 人被排除在分母之外，而不计为缺勤。 因此，它的比率取决于比小组中其他所有助手更小的样本。
  • 外观是通过将审核的企业与助理答案中指定的企业进行匹配来衡量的。 名称匹配是模糊的，仅通过其域来识别的企业（大约五分之一）是最困难的情况。 因此，存在的情况更有可能是少算而不是多算。
  • 助手是不确定的，它们的索引在不断变化。 这些数字描述了在指定窗口内给出的答案； 2026 年 8 月 2 日之后运行的相同查询将产生不同的答案。
  • 抓取信号仅从三个位置读取：主页、robots.txt 和 sitemap.xml。 在内页上包含结构化数据但在主页上不包含结构化数据的网站在此被视为没有结构化数据的网站。
  • 本版中的结构化数据数据统计不足。 直到 2026 年 8 月 2 日，检测器仅读取每个 JSON-LD 块的顶层，因此它错过了 Yoast 和大多数 WordPress 生态系统用来包装其标记的 @graph 容器。 以这种方式发布正确的 LocalBusiness 架构的网站在此处算作没有结构化数据的网站。 探测器在该日期进行了修正，因此该信号无法与下一版本进行比较。

引用和重用

可以自由复制图形，并注明出处和此页面的链接。 如需了解基本方法或特定部门的数据片段，请写信至 support@website-auditor.io 并提出您的问题。

更新历史

此页面是索引的永久主页。 每个新版本都会更新上面的数字，并在此处添加一个注明日期的行，而不是移动到新的 URL，因此链接和引用不断解析为当前数据。

  1. 2026-08-02 第二版。 该小组从 175 个站点增长到 193 个站点，现在运行到 2026 年 8 月 2 日，爬行信号语料库从 418 个站点增长到 436 个站点。 每个标题份额的变化都小于一个点：答案中提到的网站份额略小，阻止人工智能爬虫的份额略小。 Gemini 保持了该小组最广泛的影响力。
  2. 2026-07-31 第一版。 在 2026 年 7 月 23 日至 2026 年 7 月 31 日期间测量了跨助理的存在情况，这是 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 和 Perplexity 分别通过自己的提供商进行查询的第一个时期。 自 2026 年 5 月 16 日以来，对 418 个审核站点进行了抓取信号测量，每个域进行一次审核。
